item.title: NEA announces 2027 Jazz Masters class
item.description: The National Endowment for the Arts has named Terry Gibbs, Rufus Reid, Larry Ridley, Harvey Mason and John Edward Hasse as the newest musicians and advocates to receive the highest federal jazz honor.

item.title: Tech stocks end the week on a down note, despite Anthropic's mega-IPO
item.description: The stock market is ending the week down despite Anthropic's blockbuster IPO and a strong Nvidia earnings report, largely thanks to investor jitters about the future of AI.

item.title: Machine Gods: Anthropic's early days
item.description: In the wake of AI giant Anthropic's record-breaking IPO, Machine Gods hosts Kevin Roose and Casey Newton look back on the early days of the company, when less than 200 workers in a cramped office obsessed over AI safety and viewed business as an afterthought.

item.title: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
item.description: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump
